title: 第19章 针对修为精进第20章 怒而爆发
lines: “回禀大少爷，真没找到。”
“我们已经将整个宅子翻遍了，就连茅房也没落下，什么也没找到。”
“只有一些不值钱的家具，和几本很常见的下品武技。”
家仆苦笑道。
按说能让废武魂迅速突破的资源，肯定蕴含着大量的灵气。
这样的宝贝，除非装在储物法宝中，否则就像夜里的一盏明灯，很难藏得住。
而这些叛出家族的人里面，也没有人拥有储物法宝。
如此一来，要么是江战将资源藏在了所有人都想不到的隐秘之处，要么便是资源早就被江尘用完了，他们注定要白跑一趟。
江旭父子脸色阴沉。
“好哇二弟，看来你比我想象中要藏得深。”
江旭沉着脸道。
“本就没有所谓的资源，何来藏匿一说？不过是你们父子二人贪欲过头，太想当然了而已。”
“现在，你们可以走了吗？我这儿可不欢迎恶客。”
江战冷笑道。
江旭阴沉望着江战。
过了半晌，忽然一声冷笑：“没关系，既然你们已经决定要在此处落脚，想要安稳立足，少不了要与我江家有所摩擦。”
“我就不信，一群废物，背叛江家后，还能在这里活出个什么人样来。”
“我们走着瞧！”
撂下狠话，江旭父子二人便带着家仆离开。
只剩下“新江家”
的几十号人，气氛沉重。
“家主，听江旭的意思，怕是要对我们进行针对。”
“莫非是想对我们掌握的几家商铺下手？”
一个名为江桐的老武师捋着胡须，心中有所怀疑。
如今搬到西区，这一大家子的经济收入来源，便基本要靠商铺来维持。
而这也是家族发展的最大希望。
若江家针对这一块进行打压，以后的日子恐怕不会好过。
“没事，你们的商铺先正常开业，这几天我去找一些老朋友，看看有没有机会合作。”
“这偌大的玄武城，皆在城主府的管控之下，江家不过是五大家族中的末尾家族，不可能只手遮天。”
“何况我们还有三位武师，若干武徒，不比一般的小家族差。”
“只要挺过最艰难的时刻，一定能让家族逐渐繁荣起来！”
江战笑着鼓励道。
随后，一群人便与江战一起，开始讨论起了家族的发展事宜。
江尘听了一会儿便回到自己屋里修炼了。
他很清楚，自己刚才所说的话不是玩笑。
如今自己能够帮助家族的最好办法，便是努力修炼，在一个月后加入青阳宗。
到那时，江家便不再是威胁了。
“如今我已开辟十二条经脉，第十三条也相差不远。”
“但想要加入青阳宗，这点儿修为可远远不够。”
“除非能找到一些资源，加速修炼。”
江尘知道，自己最大的优势便是自己的武魂。
能够吞噬灵气、天材地宝以及各种蕴含灵气的资源，并凝结反馈精纯灵气的神龙武魂，能够帮助自己铸造极致根基，并快速突破。
content_en:
"Reporting to the young master, I really didn't find it."
"We have searched the entire house, even the latrine, and found nothing."
"There are only some worthless furniture and a few common low-grade martial arts books."
The servant smiled bitterly.
It is said that the resources that can enable the useless martial soul to break through quickly must contain a large amount of spiritual energy.
Such a treasure, unless it is contained in a storage magic weapon, is like a beacon in the night and is difficult to hide.
And among these people who rebelled against the family, no one had a magic weapon for storing things.
In this case, either Jiang Zhan hid the resources in a secret place that no one thought of, or the resources had been used up by Jiang Chen long ago, and their trip was destined to be in vain.
Jiang Xu and his son's expressions were gloomy.
"Okay, second brother, it seems you are hiding deeper than I thought."
Jiang Xu said calmly.
"There are no so-called resources, so why hide them? It's just that you two, father and son, are too greedy and take it for granted."
"Now, can you leave? I don't welcome bad guests here."
Jiang Zhan sneered.
Jiang Xu looked at Jiang Zhan gloomily.
After a while, he suddenly sneered: "It doesn't matter. Since you have decided to settle here, if you want to establish a stable foothold, you will inevitably have some friction with my Jiang family."
"I don't believe how a bunch of losers can live here after betraying the Jiang family."
"We'll see!"
After saying the cruel words, Jiang Xu and his son left with their servants.
Only the "Xinjiang Family" is left
There were dozens of people, and the atmosphere was heavy.
"Master, I'm afraid Jiang Xu will target us."
"Could it be that we want to attack some of the shops we have?"
An old martial artist named Jiang Tong stroked his beard and had doubts in his heart.
Now that they have moved to the West District, the family's source of income basically relies on shops.
And this is also the family's best hope for development.
If the Jiang family targets this area, life may not be easy in the future.
"It's okay. Your store will open as normal first. I'll go find some old friends these days to see if there's any chance of cooperation."
"This huge Xuanwu City is all under the control of the City Lord's Mansion. The Jiang family is just the last family among the five major families. It is impossible to cover the sky with one hand."
"What's more, we still have three martial arts masters and several martial arts disciples, which are no worse than ordinary small families."
"As long as we survive the most difficult moments, our family will gradually prosper!"
Jiang Zhan encouraged with a smile.
Afterwards, a group of people, together with Jiang Zhan, began to discuss the development of the family.
Jiang Chen listened for a while and then returned to his room to practice.
He knew very well that what he just said was not a joke.
The best way for him to help his family now is to practice hard and join the Qingyang Sect in one month.
By then, the Jiang family would no longer be a threat.
"Now I have opened twelve meridians, and the thirteenth is not far behind."
"But if you want to join the Qingyang Sect, this level of cultivation is far from enough."
"Unless we can find some resources to speed up our cultivation."
Jiang Chen knew that his greatest advantage was his martial spirit.
The Shenlong Wuhun, which can swallow spiritual energy, heavenly materials and earthly treasures, and various resources containing spiritual energy, and condense and feedback pure spiritual energy, can help you build the ultimate foundation and quickly break through.
title_en: Chapter 19: Focusing on improving cultivation Chapter 20: Exploding in anger
